caption:
The video captures a wide, static view of a sunset sky, where a blue gradient deepens toward the top and a bright glow bands the horizon. Scattered cumulus clouds hang overhead, their undersides rimmed in warm orange by the low sun near the horizon. In the foreground, leafy trees on the right and a low rooftop with a small chimney remain fixed in place throughout, confirming the camera does not move.

Throughout, the clouds drift slowly and continuously relative to these fixed ground silhouettes. The large dark mass on the left and the central cluster hold roughly their positions, shifting only slightly in extent as they steadily move. Meanwhile, additional orange-lit cloud progressively enters from the top edge, so the upper border, nearly clear at the start, becomes increasingly occupied.

The horizon glow and the orange rim-lighting on the undersides remain essentially constant. The slow drift simply continues. No new event interrupts the steady motion.
relations: Fixed rooftop, chimney and right-side trees anchor the frame, so clouds drift slowly against them.
The large left mass and central cluster hold rough positions, shifting only slightly in extent.
Orange-lit cloud progressively enters from the top edge, increasing upper-border occupancy over time.
Horizon glow and warm underside rim-lighting stay constant while the slow drift continues.
